# Vendored FDK-AAC

This directory contains an unmodified snapshot of
[`mstorsjo/fdk-aac`](https://github.com/mstorsjo/fdk-aac) version `v2.0.2`,
commit `801f67f671929311e0c9952c5f92d6e147c7b003`.

It is compiled as a static library for the private `airpods-linux` audio
engine. The upstream `NOTICE` file applies. Keep the source, notice, and this
version record together whenever a binary containing FDK-AAC is distributed.
